integrity: The proof uses the published classification, a classical finite-abelian-p-group mass identity, orbit-stabilizer, and an explicit GL_m automorphism count. A standalone verifier checks the finite formulas independently from partition data.
scientific_limitations: Counts labeled abelian group laws via reciprocal automorphism weights. The limiting statement fixes p and lets the p-adic exponent a tend to infinity. The structural homocyclic-Sylow classification and Hall--Cohen--Lenstra mass identity are prior; only their exact density synthesis and asymptotic consequence are claimed.
title: Positive limiting labeled density of polymorphism-homogeneous finite abelian groups
